```bash
docker run --pull always -v /mnt/hdd:/mnt/hdd --rm \
  -e MACA_PERF_DIR=/tmp \
  -v /mnt/hdd/pde_hpc/dataset:/hpc_dataset:ro -u 0 \
  --device=/dev/dri --device=/dev/mxcd --group-add video \
  harbor.sh.mxcr.io/xshi/aimodels-maca:mc3-7809-aurora-3.9.0.1@sha256:e1af10661cf4ec540a38bd66423988aa0987a0b7b77c8ef8b1596549333080d9 \
  sh -c 'export && cd /test && bash benchmark/run_aurora.sh && cat /tmp/perf'
```
